text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san, happy birthday~! Are you 
celebrating with everyone today? I'd love 
to join in too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Of course. I'd love to invite 
you."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I've already got your present ready. 
I hope you like it~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My, my, look at you fidgeting so 
excitedlyâª Even though I'm the one who 
should be thrilled, you seem even happier 
than I am.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's a true masterpiece, after all! I want 
you to see it right away.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A masterpiece... Wait, is this handmade? 
I'm impressed, you're quite dexterous!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Crafting has always been a hobby of mine, 
you see~♪ Oh, are you interested too, 
Heart-san? Would you like to make 
something together next time?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. To think you'd give me not just a 
birthday present, but something to look 
forward to afterward as well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait! Thank you for the wonderful 
invitation! It's a promise, Craft."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah, me too! I can't waaaait! ♪
